subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Reconhecer sufixos e prefixos comuns utilizados na formação de palavras em língua inglesa.

components.description_pt: Identificar sufixos latinos comuns como -tion, -ment, -able, -ible e -ous em palavras escritas
components.description_en: Identify common Latin suffixes such as -tion, -ment, -able, -ible, and -ous in written words
components.cc_component_description: Identify common Latin suffixes such as -tion, -ment, -able, -ible, and -ous in written words

components.description_pt: Aplicar conhecimento de prefixos e sufixos para esclarecer o significado de palavras desconhecidas
components.description_en: Apply knowledge of prefixes and suffixes to clarify the meaning of unfamiliar words
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of prefixes and suffixes to clarify the meaning of unfamiliar words

cc_matches.description: Decode words with common Latin suffixes.
Determine or clarify the meaning of unknown and multiple-meaning words and phrases based on grade 2 reading and content, choosing flexibly from an array of strategies.
